tema: for repeats something with each item of a list (for … of).

charla.texto: Lesson four: loops. A loop repeats something many times without you having to write it many times.
Like my life: office, bus, home. Office, bus, home. Except the loop at least ends.
jair's favorite loop: open my chat, type, delete, close. for eight years now
In my kingdom, soldiers train in loops: a thousand thrusts a day.
The prof trains in loops too, Rikka. Alone, at night, with the door closed. Have you seen his forearms…
I work out with weights! Well, with a water bottle. But it counts.
Exercise: go through the list of cups and print each one. With for and of.

lineas: // Lesson 4: loops. Fill in the blanks.
for (brew thing of list) { ... }  -> repeats the block with each thing in the list.
CAREFUL: of gives each item; in gives the positions (0, 1, 2). You almost always want of.
list.length -> how many things the list has.
Cups of coffee today: 3. Hours of sleep: not 3 either.

1.error: “{valor}” doesn't repeat anything. A loop that goes through a list starts with for.

2.error: “{valor}” gives the positions (0, 1, 2), not the cups. For each item you use of.

3.error: tazas.{valor} doesn't exist. To know how many things a list has: length.
